metadata.title: El Sueño Parfums De Luxe | Artisan Niche Fragrance
metadata.description: El Sueño Parfums creates carefully blended, characterful Extrait de Parfum fragrances. Leave a lasting impression without saying a word.

hero.title: Leave a lasting impression
hero.description: An invisible layer of your personality. Signature scents inspired by iconic fragrance profiles and carefully blended in our artisan atelier.

collection.title: Our signature scents
collection.description: A luxurious collection of Extrait de Parfum fragrances, crafted to let you appreciate quality in every note.

atelier.title: An artisan atelier, not a factory.
atelier.paragraphOne: El Sueño is a fragrance house for those who challenge the ordinary. Our aim is not to make standard products for the masses, but to offer thoughtful details that reflect your character.
atelier.paragraphTwo: We work with care in a modern, hygienic atelier, away from the impersonal feel of mass production. We study iconic niche fragrance profiles and blend them with our own essences to create long-lasting Extrait de Parfum compositions.
atelier.quote: True craftsmanship becomes an invisible signature. Get in touch with our design atelier to talk about your personal fragrance preferences.

contact.title: Find your signature scent.
contact.description: Message us to place an order, discuss a bespoke fragrance, or ask a question.
contact.location: Türkiye — online sales and boutique orders only
contact.name: Your name
contact.formNote: Your message will be prepared to send through WhatsApp.

footer.description: Where luxury meets lasting character, thoughtfully created in our design atelier.

blue-de-sueno.name: BLUE DE SUEÑO
blue-de-sueno.tagline: A deep, clean and timeless blue.
blue-de-sueno.description: Fresh citrus notes meet a woody, aromatic character in Blue de Sueño, leaving a polished, confident impression from the very first spray. Fresh enough for everyday wear, yet distinctive enough for special moments.
blue-de-sueno.usage: All seasons • Everyday and special occasions
blue-de-sueno.inspiration: Created with inspiration from an iconic blue masculine fragrance profile.

althair-noir.name: ALTHAIR NOIR
althair-noir.tagline: A dark, warm and powerful take on vanilla.
althair-noir.description: A spicy opening of cinnamon and cardamom meets the elegance of orange blossom and the rich warmth of Bourbon vanilla. Praline and precious woods add depth, leaving a sophisticated and unforgettable trail on the skin.
althair-noir.usage: Evenings and special occasions • Autumn and winter
althair-noir.inspiration: Inspired by the warm, spicy vanilla fragrance family.

tigre.name: TIGRE
tigre.tagline: A vibrant, energetic and charismatic masculine character.
tigre.description: A bright citrus opening meets powerful woody notes and warm amber nuances, giving Tigre a fresh yet confident character. As it settles on the skin, it becomes deeper, more sophisticated and more masculine.
tigre.inspiration: Echoes a modern fragrance profile that brings bright citrus and woods together.

pacifico-fresco.name: PACÍFICO FRESCO
pacifico-fresco.tagline: A modern scent that feels fresh, energetic and free.
pacifico-fresco.description: Lively citrus accents blend with cool mint, green aromatic notes and subtle fruity nuances, giving Pacífico Fresco a bright, clean and refreshing character.
pacifico-fresco.inspiration: Inspired by summer fragrances that pair a Mediterranean breeze with tropical freshness.

erba-fruta.name: ERBA FRUTA
erba-fruta.tagline: Sweet, intense and impossible to overlook.
erba-fruta.description: A lively opening of exotic fruits meets soft musk, vanilla-like warmth and creamy accents, giving Erba Fruta a bold, captivating character. A confident unisex fragrance for everyone.
erba-fruta.inspiration: Inspired by the intense, fruity unisex fragrance family.
